h: Gunmen reportedly kill 58 people in a four-hour raid on a Taraba community
p: Armed men are said to have attacked a community in Taraba State for about four hours, leaving 58 people dead according to a report. Details on the exact location and who was behind the raid are still limited, and security agencies are yet to give a full account.
more: Reports say the attack lasted around four hours before the gunmen withdrew.
Residents and local leaders are expected to press for stronger security in the area.
